title: DJ's Crafting Extras
description: This is a datapack I coded that adds extra crafting recipes. :)
body:
This is a data pack I coded that adds extra crafting recipes. Those being:

- Totem Of Undying
- Trident
- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Bottles 'o Chanting
- Saddle
- Bundle
- Elytra
- Wither Rose
- Cobweb
- String (Using White Wool or Cobweb)
- Slime Balls
- Stone Tools (Using Andesite, Granite, Tuff, Diorite, and End Stone)
- Boats (Using Nether Woods)
- Vines
